fact_label: North Carolina flat state income tax rate (2026)
notes: Scheduled to keep dropping toward 2.99% by 2028, contingent on the state hitting its own revenue-growth benchmarks each year — not a guaranteed glide path (osbm.nc.gov). A real, structural drag Chattanooga/Tennessee (0% state income tax) doesn't carry. Added 2026-07-18, backfilling income-viability.

fact_label: Tennessee Franchise & Excise Tax — single-member LLC/sole-proprietor exemption
notes: Tennessee's 0% personal income tax is real, but the Franchise & Excise Tax (6.5% of net earnings plus a net-worth-based franchise component) applies to LLCs/corporations operating in the state — a single-member LLC/sole proprietorship generally qualifies for the disregarded-entity exemption, but forming an LLC/S-corp specifically for liability protection (a plausible choice for a cash property purchase) brings this tax back into the picture. Added 2026-07-18, backfilling income-viability — genuinely new detail, not a re-tag of the existing cost-of-living-affordability 0%-income-tax row.

fact_label: Act 60 Export Services flat Puerto Rico corporate tax rate
notes: 4% flat Puerto Rico corporate tax rate, dropping to 2% for the first five years if business volume stays under $3 million/year — applies to a services business billing clients outside Puerto Rico, layered on top of the baseline IRC §933 federal exemption (see visa-legal.md). Doesn't apply to pre-existing passive income (see the companion Act 60 Investor decree facts). Added 2026-07-18, backfilling income-viability.
